Look your best.

No supplement fixes a sedentary week. No step count outruns a diet you’re guessing at. They only pay off stacked — so every package includes all four.

Included in every package All four — no tiers, no add-ons, no upsells
Performance Training

A full hour, one-on-one, coached in real time — every single session. Programming built around your body, your schedule, and how you actually move, adjusted as you progress.

Supplementation

A Thorne-backed protocol built around your training, your goals, and what your diet is actually missing. Third-party tested products, no filler, nothing you don't need.

Nutrition Tracking

Protein, calories, and the habits around them — tracked and reviewed, not guessed at. I adjust your targets as your body and your training change.

Step Tracking

The 23 hours outside the gym decide most of your results. We set a daily step target, track it week to week, and raise it as your capacity grows.

Training Packages

Every session is a full hour, one-on-one. More sessions, lower rate per session.

About

I train it.
I compete in it.
I coach it.

I'm Cooper Pate — Coach Coop. NASM certified personal trainer with 5+ years of experience, nutrition coach, Ironman triathlete, and marathon finisher. I built 1:1 Wellness because training alone was never the whole answer — what you supplement with and how much you move on your off days matter just as much.

Everything I put my clients through, I've tested on myself first. Every rep range, every supplement in the protocol, every step target — it comes from years of training, competing, and keeping only what actually works.

NASM Certified Trainer · 5+ Years
Certified methodology on every session. Not guesswork — structured, proven principles applied to your body and your goals.
Nutrition Expert · Thorne Partner Affiliate
Supplement protocols built on third-party tested Thorne products — matched to your training and your diet, not sold by the shelf.
Ironman Triathlete · Marathon Finisher
I train what I coach. Ironman triathlons and the Austin Marathon — the standard I hold myself to is the one I coach you to.
